nodes.label: Iterate Through Receipts
nodes.description: Process each transaction receipt to find deposit contract logs

nodes.label: Filter Deposit Contract Logs

nodes.label: Extract Deposit Data

nodes.label: Deposit Requests Ready

sub_graphs.title: Prague: Requests Hash Computation
sub_graphs.description: Models the cryptographic hashing process for request commitment in block headers

nodes.label: All Requests Collected

nodes.description: Apply SHA256 to each request individually

nodes.label: Individual Hashes Computed
nodes.description: SHA256 hash of each request is available

nodes.label: Chain Hashes Together
nodes.description: Concatenate and hash the individual request hashes using SHA256

nodes.label: Final Requests Hash
nodes.description: Final digest representing the commitment to all requests

nodes.description: Examine the request type byte to determine request category

nodes.label: Withdrawal Request (0x01)

ambiguities.text: The specification does not explicitly define behavior when the deposit contract emits malformed log data that passes length check but has incorrect internal structure
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume the fixed offset/size validation catches all malformed data. If a log passes validation but contains semantically invalid data (e.g., invalid pubkey), it's the consensus layer's responsibility to reject it.

ambiguities.text: The phrase 'chain hashes together' is vague about the exact concatenation and hashing order for compute_requests_hash
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume hashes are concatenated in request type order (deposits, then withdrawals, then consolidations) and a final SHA256 is computed over the concatenation.

ambiguities.text: It's unclear whether an empty list of requests produces a zero hash, empty hash, or some other sentinel value
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume SHA256 of empty input returns the standard SHA256 hash of empty string.

implicit_assumptions.description: The deposit contract at 0x00000000219ab540356cbb839cbe05303d7705fa is trusted and cannot emit fraudulent deposit events
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: A compromised or malicious deposit contract could inject fake deposits, allowing unauthorized validators to join the network

implicit_assumptions.description: The deposit contract event signature hash (0x649bbc62...) is unique and cannot be emitted by other contracts
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Topic collision could allow malicious contracts to spoof deposit events if they somehow match the signature

implicit_assumptions.description: An attacker cannot modify transaction receipts after block execution
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Receipt tampering could allow injection or removal of deposit requests, corrupting the validator set

implicit_assumptions.description: Deposit requests are processed in order and the index field is monotonically increasing
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Out-of-order or duplicate index values could cause deposit processing failures or duplicates
